title: Asking about a flat
instructions: Maria kiralık bir daire hakkında ev sahibine telefon ediyor. Uzun bir diyalog; kira, faturalar ve kurallara dikkat et.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: Hello, I'm calling about the flat on Green Street. Is it still available?

script.speaker: owner
script.text: Yes, it is. It has one bedroom, a kitchen and a small balcony.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: It's six hundred and fifty pounds a month.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: It includes water, but you pay for electricity and the internet.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: OK. Is it near the station?

script.speaker: owner
script.text: Yes, it's a five-minute walk. And there's a supermarket opposite.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: That sounds good. Can I have pets? I have a small cat.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: Sorry, no pets in the building. And no smoking.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: Oh. That's a problem. I can't leave my cat.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: I understand. I have another flat on River Road. Pets are OK there, but it's a bit more expensive.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: Can I see it on Thursday?

questions.prompt: How much is the rent on Green Street?
questions.feedback: Kira ayda altı yüz elli pound.
questions.evidence: It's six hundred and fifty pounds a month.

questions.prompt: Which bill is included in the rent?
questions.feedback: Kiraya sadece su (water) dahil; elektrik ve internet ayrı.

questions.prompt: Why is the Green Street flat a problem for Maria?
options: She can't have her cat there.
questions.feedback: Binada evcil hayvan yasak; Maria kedisini bırakamaz.
questions.evidence: Sorry, no pets in the building.

questions.prompt: What will Maria do on Thursday?
options: see the flat on River Road
see the flat on Green Street
questions.feedback: Perşembe saat altıda River Road'daki daireyi görecek.
questions.evidence: Can I see it on Thursday?
